reasonNotExecuted: dispatch: Do not execute any of those commands. Bypass of this lane is the planner running them.

ciGateAlreadyMet.instrument: GitHub check-runs API conclusion field, not gh pr checks wording
ciGateAlreadyMet.mergeLaw: conclusion string success on both jobs. This playbook does not merge.

imageTagRule.whyNeverLatest: workflow inputs.image_tag default is latest. deploy-canary does not build. R-09: workflow_dispatch 32482494494 with default latest froze digest seven seconds before Build & push of 4a52dee1 finished; canary ran 1a55566b.
imageTagRule.deployTagIsMainPushGithubSha: build-and-push runs only on push to main and tags github.sha. After merge, wait for job name Build & push image conclusion string success on the landed SHA, then pass that full sha as image_tag. If squash or merge-commit, that sha is not 6074940.
imageTagRule.openPrMergeCommitShaIsNotAnImage: 13c745b1329bbeba0296b397b9176b0ba29d9889 is the open-PR test-merge ref. Do not deploy it.
imageTagRule.yamlRefMustCarryAtomsSecret: ATOMS_DATABASE_URL is on the PR-branch --set-secrets line. Dispatch --ref main only AFTER that yaml is on main, otherwise the new revision will not mount the secret.

servingTodayDoNotShiftYet.readRule: gcloud --format=json; traffic percent by field name; digest from the revision, not the template tag

steps.name: merge PR 449
steps.gate: Typecheck conclusion success AND Test conclusion success on 6074940dc18cd241b7cde54fda7fdde2fc8fd64c already filed. Do not merge on gh pr checks pass.
steps.after: read merged=true then the landed merge SHA from the PR JSON by field name. That SHA (or the squash SHA) is the candidate image_tag, not the open-PR test-merge ref.

steps.name: wait Build & push image on the main-push SHA
steps.why: push to main is the only path that tags an image. deploy-canary does not build.
steps.verify: check-run or workflow job named Build & push image conclusion string success on the landed SHA. Confirm the Artifact Registry tag equals that full sha.

steps.name: deploy-canary
steps.exactCommand: gh workflow run "Cloud Run Deploy (cortex-api)" --repo empressaioemail-tech/legacy-design-tools --ref main -f action=deploy-canary -f image_tag=<FULL_MAIN_PUSH_SHA>
steps.exampleIfFastForwardKeepsPrHead: gh workflow run "Cloud Run Deploy (cortex-api)" --repo empressaioemail-tech/legacy-design-tools --ref main -f action=deploy-canary -f image_tag=6074940dc18cd241b7cde54fda7fdde2fc8fd64c
requiredFlags: --ref main after the ATOMS_DATABASE_URL yaml is on main
-f image_tag=<full sha never latest never omitted>
steps.poll: gh run list --repo empressaioemail-tech/legacy-design-tools --workflow "Cloud Run Deploy (cortex-api)" --json databaseId,event,headSha,status,conclusion,displayTitle,url then the run's jobs conclusion strings. MERGE-law equivalent: job Deploy 0% canary conclusion success.

expectedAfter.digestReadFrom: gcloud run revisions describe <new> --format=json status.imageDigest, not latestReadyRevisionName and not the tag

steps.name: smoke canary /api/healthz
steps.doNotSmokeDefaultUrlYet: deploy-canary uses --no-traffic because the service exists. Default URL stays 00527-yic until shift-traffic. Today the canary tag is still on 00527-yic; after step 2 it must point at the new revision before this smoke is evidence of the new image.
steps.confirmCanaryRevisionFirst: gcloud run services describe cortex-api --project=legacy-design-tools-prod --region=us-central1 --format=json; find status.traffic[] where tag==canary; read revisionName by field name; describe that revision's imageDigest

steps.name: shift-traffic 100%
steps.exactCommand: gh workflow run "Cloud Run Deploy (cortex-api)" --repo empressaioemail-tech/legacy-design-tools --ref main -f action=shift-traffic
steps.note: no image_tag on this action. Workflow runs gcloud run services update-traffic --to-tags=canary=100 then smokes production /api/healthz.
steps.verify: status.traffic[] percent 100 on the NEW revision by field name, not latestReadyRevisionName. Digest on that revision matches the sha-tagged image, not sha256:83fd0dc6.

steps.name: live GET gold facets
steps.parse: JSON by field name, never positional
failClosedIf: floodHazardFact.code === atoms-store-not-configured (secret not on the revision or yaml --ref too early)
floodZone !== X at the named field
steps.notThisProbe: https://smartsite.cloud inspect. Planner-review already showed atom-chain-warm drops floodHazardFact. This playbook grades cortex-api.

rollbackIfNeeded.exactCommand: gh workflow run "Cloud Run Deploy (cortex-api)" --repo empressaioemail-tech/legacy-design-tools --ref main -f action=rollback -f rollback_revision=cortex-api-00527-yic
rollbackIfNeeded.when: canary healthz not 200, new revision missing ATOMS_DATABASE_URL, or live GET fails closed

atomsDatabaseUrl.yamlEvidence: s1-flood-inspect .github/workflows/cloud-run-deploy.yml deploy-canary gcloud run deploy --set-secrets line includes that pair after PLAN_REVIEW_API_KEY
atomsDatabaseUrl.withoutIt: GET returns floodHazardFact.code=atoms-store-not-configured even if the inspect code is serving
atomsDatabaseUrl.servingToday: 00527-yic env secretKeyRef names do not include ATOMS_DATABASE_URL

whatBypassesThisPlaybook: planner skipping canary and shifting traffic anyway (today tag=canary is 00527-yic, so shift-traffic without a new canary is a no-op that looks like success)
omitting -f image_tag, which defaults to latest
gh workflow run --ref before ATOMS_DATABASE_URL is on that ref's yaml
gcloud run deploy / services update / update-traffic / replace-traffic outside the workflow
using the open-PR merge_commit_sha 13c745b as image_tag
merging on gh pr checks printing pass without conclusion string success
smoking the default URL after deploy-canary and treating 00527-yic healthz as the new image

threeQuestionGate.whatExecutesIt: GitHub Actions jobs deploy-canary and shift-traffic, gated on workflow_dispatch && inputs.action. Planner types the gh workflow run commands.
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: deliberate workflow_dispatch after merge and after Build & push conclusion success
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenViolated: live GET missing present/X or atoms-store-not-configured; or serving digest still sha256:83fd0dc6. Those fail only after the planner runs the commands. This file does not arm them.
